messages:
Alex M: Quick sync — cloud partner wants a single IaC adapter so their marketplace tile can target multiple clouds. Idea: keep a canonical inputs.tfvars + a small provider-specific adapter module (crosswalk) that maps to provider resources. Thoughts?
Sarah P: Sounds good. What's the minimum surface area? we should avoid duplicating too much provider logic.
Tariq: We need to handle network naming, instance sizing, GPU SKU mapping (ampere vs graviton), and image IDs. Those are the big gotchas.
Jamal: Agree. Also packaging for marketplace: they expect a single entrypoint. We can add a shim that calls the right adapter based on var.cloud.
Maria: I can own CI for this. plan: unit smoke deploy to each partner env + terraform fmt/validate + tflint.
Alex M: Nice — here's the proto adapter pattern I sketched:

```
module "adapter" {
  source = "./adapters/${var.cloud}"
  common_vars = var.common
}
```

Keep adapters tiny, real work in shared modules.
Sarah P: Can we add a compatibility matrix document? e.g., map of supported regions/SKU combos per cloud.
Tariq: I'll start a spreadsheet. We should also define fallback SKUs if exact GPU isn't available.
Jamal: For marketplace packaging, partner wants a single archive. We can include the adapters and a wrapper Makefile.
Maria: CI steps I propose:
- terraform fmt/validate
- tflint
- terratest smoke (aws, gcp, azure)
- on success, publish artifact to S3/artifact registry

Run command locally:
```
make ci-run CLOUD=aws
```

partner-bot: New ticket created: PARTNER-4123 — "cloud adapter crosswalk + CI" (assigned Alex M)
Alex M: Alex M — I'll take PARTNER-4123 as lead. Jamal — can you confirm marketplace packaging constraints by EOD Thu? :eyes:
Jamal: Yep, pinged partner PM. will update by EOD.
Sarah P: I can draft the compatibility matrix template.
Maria: I'll wire up incremental CI and post results in this thread.
Tariq: Adding initial SKU mapping to the sheet now.
Alex M: Thanks team. Next sync Thu 10am. :calendar:
